items.label: la paume
items.scene: A girl holds a shiny POMEgranate ("POHM") balanced flat on the PALM of her open hand.

items.label: la menotte
items.scene: A toddler's SMALL HAND tugs at a big rope KNOT ("muh-NOT") on the workbench, giggling.

items.label: l'habileté
items.scene: A clockmaker with great SKILL fixes a tiny watch with tweezers while A BEE arrives LATE ("ah-BEE-luh-TAY"), holding a pocket watch.

items.label: le pouce
items.scene: PUSS ("POOS") in Boots, feathered hat and all, gives a big THUMBS-UP from the top of a tool chest.

items.label: l'index
items.scene: A sailor points his INDEX ("an-DEHKS") finger at the DECKS of a model ship on the bench.

items.label: l'ongle
items.scene: A manicurist files a girl's FINGERNAIL to a perfect ANGLE ("OHNGL"), checking it with a giant wooden protractor.

items.label: le manche
items.scene: A beaver MUNCHES ("MAHNSH") the long wooden HANDLE of a broom like a carrot, chips flying.

items.label: le coude
items.scene: A dove COOED ("KOOD") softly, perched on an old carpenter's bent ELBOW as he leans on the bench.
